description:
Cast Eternal Dominion.
Eternal Dominion is exiled with Eye of the Storm.
Choose to not cast your copy of Eternal Dominion with Eye of the Storm.
Hive Mind triggers, and all other players are forced to cast Eternal Dominion.
All other players may not cast any other spells for the rest of the game because of Eternal Dominion's Epic ability, and they can not use Enduring Ideal due to Stranglehold.
